cohort: Frozen Fresh B 150 from fresh_confirm_b.txt; UID-disjoint from Fresh C and the R1 diagnostic set.
candidate_rule: Choose one candidate from Phase A/B and the development objects only. Freeze its code SHA, parameters, masks, and outputs before opening any Fresh B prediction or quality metric. Run each Fresh B UID once under baseline and candidate in a paired same-noise control. Do not tune after unblinding.

generation.gfl: constant requested scale 1.25 with existing caps
generation.precision: UNet/VAE float16; adapter and geometry encoder float32

primary_analysis_unit: object; average the five non-reference views equally within each object, then paired object-level analysis

texture_strata.source: Fresh B GT-only Laplacian-variance quartile cutpoints frozen in 1008/engineering/fidelity_validation_48h/A_QUARTILE_CUTPOINTS.json

success_thresholds.unseen_view_color_improved: five-view mean ΔCIEDE2000 <= -1.0; paired 95% CI upper < 0; >50% of objects improve
success_thresholds.high_texture_q4_no_major_regression: Q4 mean ΔCIEDE2000 <= +1.0 and CI upper < +2.0; Q4 FG-PSNR CI lower > -0.75 dB; Q4 FG-LPIPS CI upper < +0.015
success_thresholds.structure_and_detail_preserved: overall FG-PSNR CI lower > -0.50 dB; overall FG-LPIPS CI upper < +0.010; foreground L* SSIM CI lower > -0.010
success_thresholds.source_view_not_traded_away: source-view mean ΔCIEDE2000 <= +0.5 and no visible new cast in blinded sample
success_thresholds.not_extreme_sample_driven: median five-view ΔCIEDE2000 < 0 and at least 50% object-level wins

visual_review.selection: one object nearest the GT Laplacian-variance median in each frozen Fresh B quartile; tie-break by UID lexicographic order
visual_review.method_blinding: randomize A/B labels per object with a fixed key stored separately; record preference before decoding the key
visual_review.reviewer_limit: single Codex reviewer; blind labels at the image-review step, not an independent human panel

failure_policy: If any required endpoint fails its threshold or visual review shows a quality tradeoff, stop. Do not adjust the candidate on Fresh B or relabel the cohort as unseen after tuning.
